quick_skim.title: Inference for two-stage sampling in spatial surveys
quick_skim.abstract: This paper develops a design-based asymptotic theory for two-stage sampling over a continuous spatial domain. The target parameters are integral totals, or smooth functions of such totals, defined over a fixed bounded territory partitioned into an increasingly fine collection of primary sampling units. Within this fixed-area framework, we derive the order of the variance components of the Horvitz-Thompson estimator when secondary sampling units are points selected from continuous sub-regions. We establish design consistency of the estimator, as well as consistency of variance estimators under explicit regularity conditions on inclusion probabilities, sampling densities, and the study variable. The results are extended to plug-in estimators of smooth scaleinvariant functions of totals. For high-entropy first-stage designs, we further show that a H{á}jek-type variance estimator based only on first-order inclusion probabilities is consistent, and we prove asymptotic normality of both total and plug-in estimators. A simulation study inspired by forest inventory applications illustrates the finite-sample performance of the proposed estimators and variance estimators.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Two-stage sampling underlies many demographic surveys, yet its design-based inference over continuous space lacked rigorous theory. The paper derives variance component orders for the Horvitz-Thompson estimator and proves design and variance-estimator consistency, extending results to plug-in estimators of smooth functionals.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 两阶段抽样广泛用于人口与健康调查，但其在连续空间域上的设计推断缺乏严格理论。本文在固定区域框架下推导Horvitz-Thompson估计量的方差分量阶数，并在纳入概率、抽样密度等正则条件下证明估计量与方差估计量的设计一致性，进而推广到光滑尺度不变函数的插入估计量。该理论为基于两阶段设计的总体总量与比率估计提供了可靠基础。
